summary: An older man on a train directly addresses the viewer, dismantling common excuses for not learning English by comparing time wasted on reels to the 15 minutes needed for daily practice. He warns that staying stagnant will lead to future regret when their children ask what they achieved. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the English Seekho app.
